name: プレビュー対象・未公開状態・公開操作をまとめる編集帯
prompt:
Second attempt. Create a compact Japanese-localized version of the supplied Airtable toolbar crop at exactly 1850x59 px, 31.36:1. Keep the UI small and horizontally spaced like the reference; do not enlarge controls to fill the height. Use a pure white background without a card, border, or page frame.

Left group, in this order: an ON blue toggle about 28x17 px with its white knob on the right; the regular-weight 14 px label 「プレビュー対象」; a 26 px orange circular avatar with a white A; the regular-weight 14 px label 「自分」; and a small downward chevron. Keep this group compact and vertically centered.

Right group, aligned to the far right: the 14 px muted-gray status 「未公開の変更があります」; a dark charcoal Publish button labeled 「公開」, about 80x35 px with white 14 px semibold text; then a secondary light outlined button labeled 「インターフェースを共有」 with muted 14 px regular text and a height about 35 px. Allow the secondary button to be wider if Japanese copy needs room. Keep the broad white gap between left and right groups.

The source is a 59 px-tall strip: all icons, text, avatar, and buttons must fit within that height with clear top and bottom breathing room. Use compact, regular Japanese system sans typography. Keep the title and status at source-scale, not headline scale; keep the avatar and toggle visibly smaller than the buttons. Preserve the ON toggle, orange A avatar, unpublished-change status, emphasized Publish action, and secondary Share action. No extra content, decoration, additional icons, labels, or rows.
reviewNotes: Needs correction after second review. Content and translated labels are complete, but the 3:1 generator output still makes controls too tall and too prominent in the exact 1850x59 frame: toggle about 26 px vs 17 px, avatar about 40 px vs 26 px, and action buttons about 43 px vs 35 px. The title is heavier than the source. Framing ratio is within 0.4%; additional crop or resize would distort UI geometry.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
